question: If an admin gets temporary access to my account to help troubleshoot, is there a way to keep my kids' actual names hidden from them?
answer: Yes -- go to Settings, then the Account tab, where you'll find a toggle to hide your children's names from admin. When this is turned on, if an admin is ever approved for read-only access to assist with an issue, each student will just appear as "Student 1", "Student 2", and so on rather than showing their real name. Everything else on your account still displays normally.
